priceNote: Quantum computing leader — first commercial QKD product launched
summary: IonQ is the only pure-play publicly traded quantum computing company with real hardware and a credible commercial roadmap. The newly launched Clavis XG Multiplex (quantum key distribution over existing fiber) is the first product that generates real revenue today. Northland raised target to $70 on the launch. At $59, the risk/reward is asymmetric for a small speculative position — but profitability is explicitly not a focus in 2026, so this is strictly ค่าขนม sizing.

catalysts.name: Clavis XG Multiplex Launch
catalysts.description: First quantum key distribution (QKD) product allowing quantum + classical signals to share metro fiber. Targeting telecom and financial services. CEO says revenue-generating TODAY in 2026.

catalysts.name: IonQ Forte Enterprise Deployments
catalysts.description: Forte quantum computer now available on AWS Braket, Azure Quantum, and Google Cloud. Enterprise contracts for drug discovery, optimization, and finance applications ramping in 2026.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings + Revenue Guidance
catalysts.description: IonQ raised 2026 revenue outlook to $260–270M and targeting $388M in 2028. First profitable quarter expected when Clavis + enterprise scale converges in late 2026 or early 2027.

risks: Profitability not a key focus in 2026 — company explicitly burning cash on R&D and hardware
Quantum advantage over classical computing for commercial applications still unproven at scale
Competition from IBM Quantum, Google Willow, and Microsoft quantum projects with larger R&D budgets
Revenue ramp ($260–270M guidance) heavily dependent on government + enterprise contract timing
